hints.selector_select: Must be the selector of the main <select> element, not the <option> elements.
hints.selectionCriteria: Defines how Playwright should search for the option to select.
hints.submit_selector: Must be the selector of the <form> element or the button that triggers the submission.
hints.wait_navigation_form: If active, waits for the page to load after submitting the form. Disable it if the submission is via AJAX.
hints.scroll_container: Leave empty to scroll the main browser window. Use a selector to scroll a specific element.
hints.scroll_direction: The direction in which the content scrolls.
hints.scroll_amount: Amount of pixels to scroll in the specified direction.
hints.animation_steps: Number of steps to simulate mouse movement. More steps = smoother animation.
hints.force_action: If active, ignores Playwright's visibility/editability checks before dragging.
hints.file_paths: Paths must be accessible from the environment where the backend is running.
hints.screenshot_selector: Leave empty to capture the entire window or page (depending on Full Page).
hints.screenshot_full_page: If active, scrolls and captures the entire length of the page. Ignored if Selector is used.
hints.waitForNavigation: If active, waits for page to load after form submission. Disable if using AJAX.
hints.selector: Leave empty to scroll main window. Use a selector for a specific element.
hints.force: If active, ignores visibility checks before dragging.
hints.fullPage: If active, captures full page length. Ignored if selector used.
hints.path: Path on server. If empty, returns image in response.
hints.logToFile: If active, logs save to file. Otherwise, only printed to backend console.
hints.timeout: Time to listen for errors. 0 for indefinite.
hints.args: Optional. Arguments that will be passed to the JavaScript function.
hints.returnValue: If active, the script result will be saved to a variable.
hints.picker_local_only: Warning: The Picker only works in the local version. In the web demo, please enter the selector manually.
hints.switch_logic: Define the exact values you want to compare. Each case generates an output.
hints.default_path_desc: A 'default' output is always generated for when the value does not match any case.
hints.branch_mode: Defines how the next nodes will be executed: Parallel (all at once), Sequential (one by one), or Race (first to finish wins).
hints.flow_control_action: Break exits a loop, Continue skips to the next iteration, and Return stops the entire flow execution.
hints.transform_logic: Select an operation to manipulate an array of data. Use 'acc' and 'item' variables in expressions for Reduce.
hints.component_flow_id: The ID of the flow you want to execute as a reusable component.

security_config.header_desc: Adjust passive attack vectors and quality gate compliance checks before starting the security scan.
security_config.quick_desc: Passive scan of HTTP headers (CSP, HSTS, XFO) and password transmission.
security_config.standard_desc: Complete check of OWASP policies, cookie attributes, CORS, and input sanitization.
security_config.deep_desc: Intensive audit including inline DOM traps, payload injection, and PII leakage.

vectors.headerAudit_desc: Validation of HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options.
vectors.cookieAttributes_desc: Verification of protection against CSRF attacks and session hijacking.
vectors.inputSanitization_desc: Inspection of inline DOM events and 'javascript:' links.
vectors.sensitiveDataCheck_desc: Monitoring of password storage and API responses.
vectors.corsWildcardCheck_desc: Alert if 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' uses wildcards with credentials.

compliance.scorecard_desc: Active security policy compliance audit for web application. Validates HTTP headers, TLS transport, cookie security, and token storage.

SEC-HDR-CSP.desc: The Content-Security-Policy header is not configured on the served application.
SEC-HDR-CSP.rec: Configure the 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'' header on your server.

SEC-HDR-HSTS.rec: Maintain max-age value greater than 31536000 seconds.

SEC-HDR-XFO.desc: X-Frame-Options header present with value SAMEORIGIN.

SEC-HDR-XCTO.rec: Prevent browsers from MIME-sniffing static resources.

SEC-CK-HTTPONLY.desc: All session cookies include the HttpOnly flag.
SEC-CK-HTTPONLY.rec: Prevents client-side malicious scripts (XSS) from accessing session cookies.

SEC-CK-SECURE.desc: All cookies require encrypted transport under HTTPS.
SEC-CK-SECURE.rec: Maintain the Secure attribute on all authentication cookies.

SEC-CRY-TLS-VERSION.desc: TLS 1.3 connection negotiated with modern cipher algorithms.
SEC-CRY-TLS-VERSION.rec: Keep legacy SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 protocols disabled.

SEC-DAT-TOKEN-STORAGE.desc: No plaintext JWT tokens found exposed in LocalStorage.
SEC-DAT-TOKEN-STORAGE.rec: Continue storing session tokens in HttpOnly cookies.

security_live.matrix_title: Security Control Matrix & DAST Vectors Scan
security_live.vector_headers_desc: Passive inspection of Strict-Transport-Security, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type.
security_live.vector_tls_desc: Verification of HTTPS in-transit encryption, TLS certificate validity, and cipher suites.
security_live.vector_cookies_desc: Audit of HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes on user authentication cookies.
security_live.vector_storage_desc: Monitoring against storing JWT tokens or sensitive credentials in plaintext LocalStorage.
security_live.vector_sanitizing_desc: Inspection against Reflected/Stored XSS injection and vulnerable javascript: URI links.
security_live.vector_disclosure_desc: Verification of Server / X-Powered-By headers to prevent server technology fingerprinting.
security_live.monitoring_desc: Monitoring HTTP requests, server headers, and DOM sanitization...

security_live.scan_start_hint: Start the audit to begin real-time passive inspection.
